notes: Chunk 69 read 2026-10-18. All 8 listed text files are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Only the text files listed in chunk-69.json were read (the snapshot folders also hold other captures that were not in the chunk list). NUS (bschool.nus.edu.sg PhD job placement, 2017-10-18): table columns Name | Department | Year of Conferment | Appointment held upon graduation; year recorded as graduation (conferment). The appointment string was split into position (leading title) and destination (remainder); where the split was not mechanical the full wording is quoted in note. degree "PhD" comes from the page sitting in the PhD programme section (breadcrumb PhD > Alumni > Job Placement), not from a per-row degree column. Department names are kept exactly as written, including "(formerly known as Business Policy)". The page is school-wide (Accounting, Finance, Marketing, Management & Organisation, Strategy & Policy, Analytics & Operations); only Analytics & Operations rows are operations graduates. NYU Stern Management & Organizations PhD placements (2018-10-18 and 2019-10-15): the table is "Current Positions of NYU Management PhD Student Alumni" with columns Graduation Date | Current Affiliation | Position. listedYear is the graduation year (month in note); destination/position are CURRENT affiliations at capture time, not first placements. The 2019 capture adds three graduates (May 2018, May 2019) although its heading still says "2005 through 2017". Typos on the page ("Assitant", "Universtity") are kept as written. Kellogg MORS alumni page (2017-10-19): headings "YYYY Graduates"; each line gives dissertation title, year and placement; recorded as graduation year with the dissertation title in note. The same people appear on the school-wide Kellogg job placement page (2017-10-17) under "Management and Organizations" with PLACEMENT years that sometimes differ by one year (e.g. Christopher Steele 2017 graduate vs 2015 placement; Soroush Aslani, Sohyeon Shim 2015 graduates vs 2014 placement; Vanessa Pouthier, Franz Wohlgezogen 2014 graduates vs 2013 placement; Katie Liljenquist 2010 graduate vs 2007 placement; John Joseph and Niroshaan Sivanathan 2009/2010 graduates vs 2008 placement). Integrator should reconcile and not merge these years. Kellogg MORS "PhD Candidates on the Job Market" (2017-10-19): three candidates, no year printed; recorded with listedYear null and yearMeaning job-market. Email addresses on the page were not copied. Advisers appear only in note. Kellogg school-wide job placement page (2017-10-17): "Recent job placements of doctoral students ... 2007 - 2017", year headings per department; yearMeaning placement. "No students on the job market" lines (AIM 2008; MORS & Sociology 2007 and 2009-2017; OM 2009, 2012, 2015) yielded no rows. Duplicates across sections were kept as separate rows with cross-reference notes: Paolina C. Medina (Finance and MES 2017), Robert Dam (Finance 2012 and 2015), Zhuqing (Clair) Yang (MES 2016 and 2017), Mustafa Akan and Xiaoyuan Lauren Lu (MES and OM, asterisked as MES students with an OM concentration placed in operations departments). Jonathan Brogaard is written "(JD-PhD)"; Erik Loualiche is noted as an Economics PhD student with Finance advisors. The page also links a PDF of dissertations and placements since 2007 that was not in the chunk. Purdue Krannert "Alumni Achievements" (2017-10-22 and 2018-10-19; alumni content identical, only navigation differs): not a graduate list but profiles of nine named doctoral alumni with PhD year/program where stated; affiliations are current positions, not first placements.
